Demining in forward areas
*301. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the forward
areas our forces are engaged in clearing
mines without the aid of demining sets and
mine boots;
(b) if so, the number of Jawans killed
and injured so far during the demining
process; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
stop manual demining to save human lives
as well as complete the demining process
quickly?
Return and rehabilitation of
Kashmiri migrants
*302. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. ABRAR AHMED:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any action plan for the
return and rehabilitation of Kashmiri
migrants have been prepared; and
(b) if so, the status of the plan?
Crimes against women
*303. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRIMATI SHABANA
AZMI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether in the year 2002, there had
been increasing number of crimes against
women;
(b) if so, what were the main reasons
for the same;
(c) what are the efforts being made to
reduce these crimes against women in 2003;
(d) whether any proposals in this regard
have been worked out; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Special C.L. for Central Government
employees
*304. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of PERSONNEL,
PUBLIC GRIEVANCES AND PENSIONS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
employees are eligible for special C.L. when

93
WIN2\SESSION\8048RS 93
they participate in National level Sports
meet as technical officials;
(b) if so, what is the procedure in
obtaining the said leave;
(c) can Government refuse after
participation in the sports event; and
(d) if so, what is the justification?
Assistance to States affected by power
crisis
†*305. SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of State Governments
which have sought assistance from Central
Government to get rid of power crisis;
(b) the details thereof, State-wise; and
(c) the details of the provision made by
the Central Government to rid the States
out of the power crisis?
Schemes for rural electrification
*306. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the Central Schemes
under which Rural Electrification Programmes
are being launched in the country;
(b) the State-wise break up of the
allocation of funds and achievements made
in the electrification of villages during last
three years (scheme-wise);
(c) the number of villages in the State of
Orissa which are yet to be electrified; and
(d) the target date fixed for the
electrification of those villages?
Development of "Controlled Shunt
Reactor (CSR)" for power transfer
*307. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Bharat Heavy Electricals
Limited (BHEL) has developed a unique
device, called "Controlled Shunt Reactor
(CSR)" the first of its kind in the world, for
improving power transfer capability and
reducing transmission losses;
(b) whether it is a major breakthrough
for the country's power transmission
sector and whether this has been
commissioned at Power Grid, Itarsi in
Madhya Pradesh, as reported in the
Hindustan Times dated the 22nd December,
2002; and
(c) the places where it is now proposed
to be installed?
Production of coking coal
†*308. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that production
of coking coal in the country is decreasing
constantly since last year;
(b) if so, the production during the year
1999-2000;
(c) the assessment with regard to the
production of the said coal during the current
financial year; and
(d) the reasons for decrease in
production constantly?
Priority to drought affected States
under "Haryali" scheme
†*309. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have handed

benefited by this new "Haryali" scheme
from amongst two lakh thirty two thousand

(c) whether drought affected States have
been given priority under this scheme; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Power sector reforms

Accidents in coal mines
†2162. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA: Will the Minister of COAL be
pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise details of accidents
and fire incidents in coal mines/headquarters
during last three years;
(b) the State-wise details of the loss
occurred to men and property in these
accidents; and
(c) the details of the measures taken to
prevent such accidents?
Erection of barbed fencing along the
Pakistan border
†2163. SHRI D.P. YADAV: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of infiltration attempts
by Pakistan trained terrorists into Indian
territory alongwith the number of times the
skirmishes took place with Pak rangers at
the time of erection of barbed wire fencing
on the borders; and
(b) whether work related to erection of
barbed wire fencing has been completed on
the borders, if so, when and if not, the
reasons therefor?
Educational scholarships to children of
army employees by Coca Cola
2164. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Army have received an
offer from the Coca Cola Company to give
educational scholarships to children of army
employees;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how Government propose to utilise
the offer fully as a welfare measure for the
families of Army Jawans?
News-item captioned 'Arms deal in the
making'
2165. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item in Frontline
dated the 16th August, 2002 on 'Arms deal
in the making'; and
(b) if so, what is the progress in this
matter and the time-frame for induction of
new artillery system?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Complaints received by Station
Commander, Nasirabad
2166. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
SHRI VIJAY SINGH YADAV:
 Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Station
Commander of Nasirabad in the capacity of
Chairman of Schools has received
complaints against the Principals during
preceding three years;
(b) if so, the details case-wise/
complaint-wise; and
(c) what action has been taken in each
case; and
(d) whether Chairman/Station
Commanders have sent the cases to their
higher authorities along with his
recommendations and the out-comes in each
case?
Raising of Manipur Regiment
2167. SHRI RISHANG KEISHING:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the demand for raising of
'Manipur Regiment' in Indian Army
Stands; and
(b) how long it will take to materialise
the demand into reality?
Precautions to certain air crashes
2168. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Versova-based mother of late Flt-Lt Abhijit
Gadgil, who died in MIG-21 air-crash in
September, 2001, has set "The Abhijit Air
Safety Foundation", seeking to unite parents
of over 100 dead fighter pilots of MIG-21
crashes, for seeking rational explanation on
continuing MIG crashes; and
(b) if so, whether adequate safety
precautions exist to contain this continuing
trend of air crashes?
Pensionary benefits to families of
deceased IL-38 naval officers
2169. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the families of
twelve naval officers and men killed in mid-
air collision accident of two naval planes in
Goa have been denied pensionary and other
benefits fixed for those who died on actual
duty;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) what steps are being taken to honour
those brave naval officers?
Extension of boundary of Ammunition
Depots at Hatiali, Dibrugarh, Assam
2170. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether a proposal for extension of
boundary of Ammunition Depots at Hatiali
of Chabua Revenue circle of Dibrugarh
District, Assam is being finalized by Defence
authorities;
(b) if so, total area to be extended
and detailed status of the land proposed
for extension indicating the date of
Gazette Notification made for the
purpose; and
(c) village-wise total number of
families inhabited in the said notified area
including institutions and commercial
establishments?

to state:

Government have arrived at agreement for
the supply of parts of Bofors gun and the
details thereof;
